description: This is a Java test class for the KeyboardThemeFactory component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It tests the behavior of observing theme changes when preferences are modified.

classes.name: KeyboardThemeFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the KeyboardThemeFactory, particularly the theme change notifications when preferences are updated.

methods.name: testObserveCurrentThemeFiredWhenPrefChanges
methods.description: Tests that the current theme is correctly updated and observed when preferences change, including initial value and subsequent updates.
